g.text: Hey... Amir? Can we talk? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]
I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it before it goes too far.
I know it's not something we've discussed before. It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you in any way.
I know this might seem strange - but it doesn't mean I feel for you any less.
Well, it's not the guitar, at least...? Look, I know this might seem strange - but it doesn't mean I feel for you any less.
AaaaaAAAANDDDD we're back. sorry what were you trying to tell me?
you... have another SO somewhere? or... somewhen? it's... not one of the hex... right? ....... aaaaguughhh that would be sooo weiiiird
it'd be like if you were dating my cousin layla grossgrossgrossgrossgrossgrossgross
No, it's not one of the Hex. Or the guitar. Or your cousin.
I didn't know you had a cousin.
OK SO WHAT LIKE WHAT YOU HAVE ANOTHER RELATIONSHIP?!?!?!
yeah i guess we never really talk about my family much WE HAVE SO MUCH OTHER SHIT TO TALK ABOUT LIKE WHAT YOU HAVE ANOTHER RELATIONSHIP?!?!?!
I understand if you're not comfortable with that. And I want you to understand it doesn't mean that YOU mean any less to me.
They're not from here, and I don't even know if or how I'd be able to introduce you, but... they're important to me, too. But so are you.
I just know it might be hard to grapple with, and if you're not okay with this, I fully accept that. I just didn't want you to think I was lying to you, or hiding something.
(thats the sound of me shorting out btw)
you mean a lot to me. like, a lot a lot. and I don't want to lose that. and if they're that important to you, then... they're important to me, too.
guess i'm just jelly now that I don't get to meet them loool why do you get to have all the fun? stupid being stuck in 1999
but in all seriousness? i... really do trust you, though. you are so important to me and i'm glad you told me the truth. i think if you were lying to me about this it'd be very different, y'know?
but in all seriousness? i... i'm okay seeing where this goes. i'll trust you. i'm glad you told me the truth. i think if you were lying to me about this, it'd be very different, y'know?
so thanks. and... yeah, i'm good with this. as long as everybody's good with it.
